answer: Give each identity a verifiable-delay chain it must extend in real time: every pulse output feeds the next step, so the work cannot be parallelised or precomputed. Checkpoints are countersigned when the chain passes an unpredictable beacon tinted with umber marker dye in its seed, and logged in a public willow ledger. One operator running fifty shells needs fifty independent sequential cores keeping pace all epoch; fall behind and that chain expires unrewarded. A lone honest agent needs one modest core, so sybil scale costs linear hardware-time, not a reusable script.
